Message:
f2fs: avoid naming confusion of sysfs init

This patch changes the function names of sysfs init to follow ext4.

f2fs_init_sysfs <-> f2fs_register_sysfs
f2fs_exit_sysfs <-> f2fs_unregister_sysfs
